mcqs.question: At the Asian U15 Boxing Championships held in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, how many medals did India win?
mcqs.explanation: India won a total of 27 medals at the Asian U15 Boxing Championships in Tashkent, comprising 9 gold, 6 silver and 12 bronze medals. The figure 14 refers to the total medals won by the U15 girls, while 13 was the boys’ tally.

mcqs.question: Which city is scheduled to host the 22nd Commonwealth Table Tennis Championships 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The 22nd Commonwealth Table Tennis Championships 2026 will be held at Thyagaraj Stadium in New Delhi from 27 July to 2 August 2026. Tashkent is associated with the Asian U15 Boxing Championships, Lausanne is the headquarters of the ITTF, and Thyagaraj Stadium is the venue rather than the host city.
